section_header: W58 MANUAL TRANSMISSION — COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL
ocr_text:
MT1–16
W58 MANUAL TRANSMISSION  –  COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

(b)   Remove the No.2 shift fork set bolt.
Torque: 20 N·m (200 kgf·cm, 14 ft·lbf)

MP0027

(c)   Remove the bolt and reverse idler gear shaft stopper.
Torque: 25 N·m (250 kgf·cm, 18 ft·lbf)

MP0028

(d)   Remove the reverse idler gear and shaft with the snap ring.

G03883

(e)   Remove the No.1 shift fork and shaft.

MP0030

(f)   Using a magnetic finger, remove the No.1 and No.2 interlock pins.
INSTALLATION HINT: Apply MP grease to the No.1 and No.2 interlock pins.

WM0308 WM0031
Z02511
